description.en: Lets you pick already-configured provider/model routes into an ordered rotation pool and fail over to the next healthy route in the same turn when the current one reports exhausted quota (optionally also on 401/403 auth errors); a sidebar panel orders the pool and shows the live route, cooling providers and recent switches.
description.zh: 把已配置的供应商/模型手动加入有顺序的轮换池：当前路由额度用尽时，同一轮内自动切到下一条可用路由（可选在 401/403 认证失败时也切换）；侧边栏面板可调整顺序，并显示当前路由、冷却中的供应商与最近切换记录。
